CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE
  ALHAMBRA TRANSPORTATION COMMISSION
  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 24, 2024
  6:00 p.m.

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a Special Meeting of the
Alhambra Transportation Commission will be held on Wednesday,
January 24, 2024 at 6:00 p.m. at Alhambra City Hall Conference Room A,
111 South First Street, Alhambra, California, pursuant to the order of the
Alhambra Transportation Commission Secretary.

An agenda of such regular meeting is attached hereto, incorporated herein by
reference and made a part hereof as though fully set forth herein.

  Martin Ray
  Alhambra Transportation Commission Secretary

Notice No: N2M24-10
Posted:  January 23, 2024
   CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  AGENDA
  Special Meeting
  ALHAMBRA TRANSPORTATION COMMISSION
  City Hall, 111 South First Street
  January 24, 2024
  6:00 p.m.

  ROLL CALL:
  Steven Placido, Henry Aviles, Cliff Bender, Antonio Chavira, Gwen Chen,
  Omar Galica, Lilian De Loza Gutierrez, Albert Lu, Monica Calderon

  PRESENTATIONS

  1. ALTA PLANNING + DESIGN, INC. WILL PRESENT THE ALHAMBRA BIKE AND
  PEDESTRIAN PLAN AND PROVIDE FOR INPUT ON THE PROPOSED NETWORK AND
  PROIRITY PEDESTRIAN IMPROVEMENTS

  A link to the plan is provided below.

  https://cityofalhambra.org/DocumentCenter/View/5010/Alhambra-Bike-Ped-Plan

  Recommended Action

  It is recommended that the Transportation Commission provide comments on the presentation as
  appropriate, listen to public comment and provide direction.

  2. PUBLIC COMMENTS

  Comments must pertain to the business of the Transportation Commission. Kindly limit all oral
  communications to five (5) minutes.

  3. COMMENTS AND CONCERNS FROM COMMISSION MEMBERS AND/OR STAFF.

  Comments, concerns or discussion on any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items discussed
  must pertain to the business of the Alhambra Transportation Commission.

  4. ADJOURNMENT

  Adjournment to a regular meeting on Wednesday, March 13, 2024 at 6:00 p.m.

  Copies of staff reports or other written documentation, if any, relating to each item of business
  described above are on file in the Alhambra City Hall, Public Works Department, 111 S. First
